purpose: Seven optional connected Mura stories that reveal the whole FOLKOOP system without making future or external capabilities look shipped.

story_status_vocabulary.current_partial: Current authored fixture/capabilities cover part of the chain; missing links remain explicit.
story_status_vocabulary.current_slice: A meaningful current slice exists, but the full target/outcome chain is incomplete.
story_status_vocabulary.target_bridge_with_current_city: Current City runtime exists; cross-domain next-action bridge is target work.
story_status_vocabulary.approved_target: Owner-approved target story with current supporting surfaces but no end-to-end runtime.
story_status_vocabulary.approved_target_future_prototype: Approved target story whose technical proof is explicitly future work.

experience_rules: Stories are optional and cross-linked; they must not become one enormous mandatory tour.
Mura stays read-only and does not mutate real account/network state.
Mura and her circle are authored illustrative data.
System/privacy/source facts remain system voice rather than Mura pretending to be policy documentation.
Shipped, illustrative and target steps must be visibly distinguishable.
No signup pressure appears until explicit Mura exit.
Every implemented user-facing cluster eventually needs at least one linked Mura story and one real-user acceptance scenario.
A story may use truthful official City sources while the personal narrative around them remains illustrative.

current_contract_conflict.existing_contract: Before Online Center Göteborg v0, MURA_ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT.md hid Center in Mura navigation.
current_contract_conflict.controlling_target: Foundation Charter §9 requires Mura to include Center and the Göteborg local-community context as that slice becomes available.
current_contract_conflict.handling: Resolved for v0: runtime and acceptance contract now allow an authored read-only Online Center Göteborg story. Staffed Host/referral operation, live forum synchronization and physical venue claims remain explicitly unimplemented.

stories.title: A concrete Need becomes a useful borrowed resource
stories.question: I need a tool for one real task. Can FOLKOOP connect the need to a person/resource and show what happened next?
current_fixture_evidence: apps/web/network-ui.js: open illustrative Need 'Borrow a tile cutter for the weekend'
apps/web/network-ui.js: completed illustrative Need 'Borrowed a folding ladder'
stories.current_gap: The fixture shows an open tool need and a separate completed borrowing story, but not yet one continuous Need → matched Resource/Person → coordination → independently classified Outcome chain.

steps.description: Mura has a concrete short-lived tool need.
The need exists as a Need cooperation object with place/context.
Show the relevant resource and the person/steward who can make the next step possible.
Use the linked work chat/updates where membership permits; do not invent a chat if the fixture does not contain one.
Tool is borrowed and returned outside the app.
Represent the useful result separately from cooperation status and attach evidence/confirmation level.

truth_boundary: A current done status is not a confirmed real-world Outcome.
The visitor must understand that Mura and the lender are authored illustrative people.
No real inventory availability is implied.
acceptance: Visitor can explain why a Need is more useful than an unstructured post.
Visitor can follow the story from need to person/resource to coordination.
Visitor can distinguish a completed UI state from confirmed real-world outcome evidence.

stories.title: An Offer becomes useful help in another person's project
stories.question: I can help with photography. How does that become useful work instead of a profile claim?
current_fixture_evidence: apps/web/network-ui.js: Mura Offer 'I can help with photography'
apps/web/network-ui.js: completed 'Repair café afternoon'
apps/web/network-ui.js: completed 'Photographed the repair café'
apps/web/network-ui.js: completed repair-café photography task
stories.current_gap: The ingredients exist and completed states are visible, but the UI does not yet expose a first-class Outcome/evidence chain tying the Offer to the project result.

steps.description: Mura exposes a concrete photography Offer.
A neighbourhood repair project needs useful contribution.
Photography becomes a concrete project task rather than a generic profile skill.
The task is completed and project narrative records real-world work.
Future story links contribution to an Outcome with confirmation/evidence level.

truth_boundary: Completed fixture text is an authored story, not evidence about real participants.
Skill text and Offer are not credentials or proof of competence.
No public photo-consent claim is implied by completing a photography task.
acceptance: Visitor can explain the difference between having a skill and contributing it to a real project.
Visitor can navigate Offer → Project → Task without treating people as followers.
Visitor understands that outcome evidence needs a separate confirmation layer.

stories.title: A small idea grows into a project with people, tasks and a work chat
stories.question: I have a small local idea. How does it gain people and next actions without disappearing in a feed?
current_fixture_evidence: apps/web/network-ui.js: active illustrative Project 'Plant and seed exchange'
apps/web/network-ui.js: project tasks, updates, participants and linked work chat
apps/web/network-ui.js: completed 'Prepare a small sign' task
stories.current_gap: The project workspace exists, but the story is active rather than independently outcome-classified and is not yet linked to Center/Activity as a first-class object.

steps.description: Mura starts with a concrete neighbourhood exchange idea.
The idea becomes a Project with stated purpose.
Specific people are connected because of roles/contributions, not follower count.
Tasks, updates and work chat turn the idea into coordinated next actions.
Future Center/Activity/Place objects make the real gathering and partner location explicit.
Record the event outcome and whether participants continue into another cooperation.

truth_boundary: A Project card is not 'launched' merely because it exists.
Physical venue availability must not be invented.
Participant-led activity does not imply a formal legal organisation.
acceptance: Visitor can follow Project → Person → Task → Chat/Update.
Visitor can identify the next unfinished task.
Visitor understands that a real gathering/outcome happens outside the coordination UI.

stories.title: A group purchase coordinates demand, supplier terms and pickup without pretending to be checkout
stories.question: Several people need the same thing. Can they coordinate quantities, supplier terms and pickup without FOLKOOP pretending to hold money or place the legal order?
current_fixture_evidence: apps/web/network-ui.js: active illustrative Shared Purchase 'Dry firewood together'
apps/web/network-ui.js: purchase confirmation state and Omar logistics relationship
current DB: purchase commitments/offers/choice/process/confirmations
stories.current_gap: The shared-purchase slice is implemented, but the broader preserved economic cycle—production, sales, storage, logistics/returns and specialist accounting/payment integrations—is not complete.

steps.description: Participants state quantities for a shared purchase.
Supplier offers can be compared and one can be selected as a coordination preference.
Participants confirm/decline frozen quantities before external order.
Organizer records that an order was placed outside FOLKOOP; FOLKOOP does not send or verify the order.
Delivery/pickup and participant collection can be coordinated.
Outcome/evidence and the wider production/sale/logistics cycle remain future slices.

truth_boundary: No checkout, escrow, payment custody or binding supplier order is created by current FOLKOOP.
Organizer delivery/order notes are self-reported unless separately evidenced.
Price/offer data does not certify supplier identity or qualification.
acceptance: Visitor can explain the difference between coordination and payment/order execution.
Visitor can see why frozen confirmation exists before an external order marker.
Visitor can identify the path from group demand to pickup and a later Outcome.

stories.title: An official City question leads to a human or cooperative next step
stories.question: I have a city question or problem. Can I find the authoritative route and then connect it to people/resources/projects without FOLKOOP pretending to be the authority?
current_fixture_evidence: docs/DATA_MODEL.md: source-first CivicFeedEnvelope/CivicItem
apps/web/app.js: Göteborg City routing and official-source handoffs
apps/web/app.js + apps/web/folkoop.js: explicit same-origin source-context handoff to Online Center v0 for normalized Göteborg open plans and Riksdagen documents
Mura City mode may read truthful public/official sources
stories.current_gap: City → FOLKOOP v0 now carries a bounded, allowlisted official source context into Online Center and exposes current People/Communities/Together/Projects routes. It does not persist a first-class City Process, auto-create cooperation, bridge NVDB/report drafts yet, or preserve the source as a stored relation after a later cooperation is created.

steps.description: Mura starts from a concrete city question, not an agency name.
FOLKOOP shows source/provenance and the authoritative route/responsible actor when available.

For normalized Göteborg open plans and Riksdagen documents, the user may explicitly continue into Online Center while retaining the official source link, then choose Communities, People, Together or Projects.

The source context remains visible in the in-memory Center handoff card while the user chooses an existing cooperative route; no cooperation is auto-created and the context is not yet persisted into a first-class City Process relation.
Record whether the official/community/project next step was actually useful.

truth_boundary: source != claim; fetched/derived data must remain distinguishable from an authority decision.
FOLKOOP must not claim that an official report was submitted unless the official system confirms it.
The bridge never auto-publishes a Need/Project or submits an official case.
Mura may use real public source data, but her personal story around it remains illustrative.
acceptance: Visitor can identify and reopen the original official source after entering FOLKOOP.
Visitor can distinguish FOLKOOP guidance from public authority.
Visitor can choose at least two cooperative next-action routes without an automatic post/project being created.
Mura can use the same bridge read-only without turning public source data into a claim about her real activity.

stories.title: Online Center Göteborg connects ordinary community life, Host navigation and city/partner opportunities
stories.question: I arrive with a vague question or simply want local community. Can I enter an online/hybrid Center, talk normally, and get a useful human next step without being forced into a task workflow?
current_fixture_evidence: apps/web/folkoop.js: Online Center Göteborg v0 connects People, Communities, City, Together and Projects
apps/web/folkoop.js: Mura can open Center under the City context
apps/web/folkoop-copy.js: Göteborg external-community context is labelled as non-synchronized
Box Center master spec: Host flow Welcome → Consent → Need → Match → Handoff → Follow-up
Box Göteborg forum source preserves ordinary topical conversation, peer support, moderators, meetings/services/exchange
stories.current_gap: Online Center v0 now provides connected self-service routes and an authored Mura Göteborg context. Staffed Host consent/clarification, warm referral/follow-up, live forum synchronization, first-class Center/Place/Activity objects and any physical venue remain unimplemented.

steps.description: Selected Göteborg context can expose the local Center surface; another city does not receive fabricated Göteborg community context.
Mura shows authored local-community context; signed-in Göteborg users may open the external community via a plain outbound link with no data synchronization.
A future staffed Host asks whether the person wants navigation/help before matching.
A future Host clarifies the person's question/need without profiling by appearance/background.
Center offers current routes to People, Communities, City, Together and Projects; it does not pretend a human referral occurred.
Future warm referral has a concrete next step and preserves source/provider identity.
Future follow-up asks whether the referral/connection was used/useful without surveillance.

truth_boundary: Do not claim a physical Center venue is open.
Do not claim a live Telegram/forum integration exists.
Do not import/copy/link real forum members, identities or messages without separate authorization.
Use authored illustrative people/messages for Mura's local Center story.
No contact sharing without consent and no unsolicited matching pressure.
Ordinary community conversation remains valid; FOLKOOP must not force every interaction into a Need/Project.
acceptance: Visitor can explain what an online/hybrid Center adds beyond a forum and beyond a directory.
Visitor can move from Center to People, Communities, City, Together or Projects without encountering a fake Host workflow.
Visitor understands that staffed Host/referral/follow-up is not operating in v0.
Göteborg visitor can distinguish the external local-community link from FOLKOOP-synchronized data.
Mura visitor understands that local people/messages are authored illustration rather than copied forum content.

stories.title: A shared decision becomes an authorised action with evidence and an independently checkable integrity anchor
stories.question: When several people or organisations make a consequential shared decision, can FOLKOOP show what version was agreed, who had authority, what action followed and what evidence exists—without putting personal data on a blockchain?
current_fixture_evidence: docs/FOUNDATION_CHARTER.md: blockchain required as a scoped workstream
docs/architecture/SDCF_INTEGRATION.md: decision/plan/action/evidence distinctions
docs/architecture/TRUST_IDENTITY_WEB4_ARCHITECTURE.md: operational DB remains source of truth
stories.current_gap: No Agreement/Decision/Outcome/Attestation first-class runtime and no blockchain testnet proof are shipped.

steps.description: People see the objective, constraints and alternatives before a consequential group decision.
Record selected alternative, purpose, authority/participants and version.
Store the actual agreement/decision document off-chain with explicit versioning.
Trace a plan and authorised controlled action back to the decision.
Separate participant claims, multi-party confirmations and external evidence.
Anchor only an appropriately designed commitment/hash in a real testnet transaction and independently verify it.
Corrections/revocations create new traceable state; immutable anchor does not make an incorrect claim true.

truth_boundary: No profile, private message, home address, forum membership or sensitive request goes onto a public immutable ledger.
Hashing alone is not assumed to anonymise personal data.
No simulated receipt may be presented as an actual blockchain transaction.
No mandatory wallet, seed phrase, token, NFT or crypto payment for ordinary users.
Blockchain integrity does not prove real-world truth, valid authority or legal validity.
acceptance: Visitor can distinguish Agreement, Decision, Action, Outcome, Evidence and Integrity Anchor.
A specialist can independently verify the testnet anchor from public chain data when the prototype exists.
Ordinary FOLKOOP use remains available when the chain is unavailable.
